sentences.text: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANOOP KUMAR MENDIRATTA  ORDER % 16.01.2024 CRL.M.A. 1428/2024 & 1429/2024
Exemptions allowed, subject to just exceptions.

Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('Cr.P.C.') has been preferred on behalf of the petitioners for quashing of FIR No. 494/2020 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at P.S. : Dayalpur.
Learned APP for the State appears on advance notice and accepts notice.
Status report / reply be filed before the next date of hearing with an advance copy to learned counsel for the petitioners.
Respondent No. 2 be served by all permissible modes including through I.O. on necessary steps being taken by the petitioners, returnable on 19.03.2024.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
